fields.description: The caller's own request/correlation id when one is available (reused, never minted fresh), so this row joins the throw to the request that triggered it. A fresh hash when the caller carries none.
fields.label: Correlation ID

fields.description: The stable rule identifier that fired, e.g. admission.RULE_ID_INSTANCE_COUNT_CAP -- never the human-readable throw message, which can be reworded without changing the rule.
fields.label: Rule ID

fields.description: The plan's instance cap this call was judged against -- already computed locally before the throw, no new lookup needed.
fields.label: Limit

fields.description: The caller's active_instances count at the moment of refusal.
fields.label: Count
